title: PowerPoint text extraction joins paragraphs and drops tables inside graphicFrame
prompt: Read a PPTX containing multiple paragraphs and a native schedule table inside a graphicFrame, then ask about its exact time ranges.

assertions.requiredBehavior: Preserve paragraph boundaries and styled runs, retain table cells and following text, and derive a concise slide title.
